name: Rimehollow Delve
description: An old dwarven delve sunk into the ice, its entrance a black mouth in a glacier wall.

discovery.message: A square-cut doorway in the glacier wall, half buried in snow: an old delve.

entrance.text: Cut stone steps lead down into the ice. Your breath hangs in front of you, and the walls are glazed with frost.

requirements.description: You need a light to go underground.

entrance.failure_text: Past the entrance it's black as pitch. You'd need a lit torch or lantern, or eyes that see in the dark, to go any further.

hazard.text: The cold down here gets into your bones. Every step takes more out of you.

face.text: The first gallery's face is laced with iron, and deeper, darker veins of deepiron catch your light.

way-down.text: Beyond the face the delve drops away down a shaft glazed with ice. Far below, your light catches on something pale and gleaming.

requirements.description: The shaft is sheer ice: you need a rope.

depths-entry.failure_text: The shaft is sheer ice, straight down. You'd need a rope, and a light, to get down there.
depths-entry.text: You tie off your rope to an old iron ring in the wall and lower yourself into the dark.

depths-climb.text: Halfway down the rope stiffens with frost and your hands start to slip.
depths-climb.success_text: You lock your legs round the rope and work your way down to the floor.
depths-climb.failure_text: Your grip goes and you drop the last stretch onto the ice.

depths-fall.text: You land hard on the ice.

depths-cold.text: The Rime Galleries are colder than the ice above: a cold that bites through furs and settles in your chest.

depths-mephits.text: Two shapes of jagged ice peel themselves off the gallery wall, cackling.

depths-face.text: The old dwarves' deepest face, rimed with frost. Deepiron runs through it in dark bands, and pale moonstone and blue sapphire glitter in the ice-bound rock: the reason they dug this far.

depths-junction.text: The gallery ends in a wall of solid ice. The only way out is back up the rope.

leave.text: You climb back up into the daylight.
